artifact_observations.reasoning: The entire image suffers from significant softness and lack of sharp focus, likely due to the vintage nature or low resolution of the source, obscuring fine details like petal edges and leaf structures.

The green foliage in the background lacks distinct leaf shapes, appearing as smeared, painterly blobs rather than defined plant structures, which is common in low-res AI generations or heavily compressed images.
The long, thin leaf/stem structure extending to the right seems to float without a clear connection point to the main stem or ground, fading into the black background ambiguously.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification despite the low resolution and verify it is not a similar composite flower like a chamomile or aster.
To assess the severity of the blur and grain, determining if it represents natural vintage photography characteristics or AI-generation smoothing artifacts.
To check for edge bleeding between the white petals and the dark background, ensuring the petals are distinct entities and not melting into the void.
To verify the spatial relationship between the foreground flowers and the background foliage, ensuring the stems do not pass through leaves illogically.

Structural integrity of the stems (no floating or broken segments)
